title: Payoff Quotes, Collections and Credit Reporting While on a Plan
content:
Halverson Clinical Laboratories applies the following payoff and account-protection settings to every term of **Patient Payment Plans**. They govern how long a payoff figure quoted to a patient holds, what a payoff does to the invoices, and how invoices on a plan stand with collections and credit reporting.

| Term | Payoff quote valid (calendar days) | Payoff pays every invoice on the plan | Invoices kept out of collections while the plan is active or past due | Current-plan balance may be reported to credit bureaus |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 3-Month Payment Plan | 10 | Yes | Yes | No |
| 6-Month Payment Plan | 10 | Yes | Yes | No |
| 9-Month Payment Plan | 10 | Yes | Yes | No |
| 12-Month Payment Plan | 10 | Yes | Yes | No |
| 18-Month Payment Plan | 10 | Yes | Yes | No |
| 24-Month Extended Payment Plan | 10 | Yes | Yes | No |

## Settings explained

1. **Payoff quote valid** — a payoff amount quoted to the patient stays valid for 10 calendar days on every term.
2. **Payoff pays every invoice** — paying the plan off pays every invoice the plan carries.
3. **Kept out of collections** — while a plan is active or past due, the invoices on it are never placed in collections.
4. **Credit reporting** — a balance on a current plan may not be reported to credit bureaus on any term.

## Points of reference

- The protection from collections covers the active and past-due standings only; the setting says nothing about a plan that has defaulted, been cancelled or been paid off.
- Because every term carries the same values, a change of term never changes these protections.
